import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem mathd_numbertheory_229 : 5 ^ 30 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h1 : (5 : ℤ) ^ 6 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    norm_num [Int.ModEq, Int.emod_eq_emod_iff_emod_sub_eq_zero]
    <;> decide
  
  have h2 : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    have h3 : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 = ((5 : ℤ) ^ 6) ^ 5 := by
      norm_num [pow_succ, pow_mul]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> norm_num
    rw [h3]
    
    have h4 : ((5 : ℤ) ^ 6 : ℤ) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := h1
    have h5 : (((5 : ℤ) ^ 6) ^ 5 : ℤ) ≡ (1 : ℤ) ^ 5 [ZMOD 7] := by
      
      calc
        (((5 : ℤ) ^ 6) ^ 5 : ℤ) ≡ (1 : ℤ) ^ 5 [ZMOD 7] := by
          
          exact Int.ModEq.pow 5 h4
        _ = (1 : ℤ) ^ 5 := by rfl
    
    have h6 : (1 : ℤ) ^ 5 = (1 : ℤ) := by norm_num
    rw [h6] at h5
    exact h5
  
  exact h2
